**1 — Scene:** A light breakfast: cooked tomatoes, mushrooms, a fried egg, two slices of seeded bread, and a glass of milk.

**2 — Vessels:** Main plate approximately **24 cm** across (area **452 cm²**); bread plate approximately **20 cm** (area **314 cm²**). The glass is approximately **8 cm** across (cross-sectional area **50 cm²**).

**3 — Items:** Tomatoes, mushrooms, egg, seeded bread, milk, and a small amount of visible cooking oil. The tiny herb garnish is included with the tomatoes.

**4–6 — Area, volume, and weight:**

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × average height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Tomatoes | 22% of main plate | 99 × 1.6 = 158 ml | 0.70 g/ml | 111 g |
| Fried egg | 14% of main plate | 63 × 0.75 = 47 ml | 1.00 g/ml | 47 g |
| Mushrooms | 19% of main plate | 86 × 1.7 = 146 ml | 0.60 g/ml | 88 g |
| Seeded bread | 55% of bread plate | 173 × 1.5 = 260 ml | 0.30 g/ml | 78 g |
| Milk | Full glass cross-section | 50 × 4 = 200 ml | 1.03 g/ml | 206 g |
| Cooking oil | Thin sheen on cooked items | Approximately 3 ml | 0.92 g/ml | 3 g |

Food covers approximately **55% of each plate**. Oil overlaps the cooked foods rather than adding separate coverage. Bread uses an airy loaf density, with no additional reduction.

**7 — Energy:** Tomatoes approximately **28 kcal**, mushrooms **25 kcal**, egg **73 kcal**, bread **203 kcal**, milk **103 kcal**, and oil **27 kcal**. Milk is estimated as semi-skimmed; its fat content is not visually identifiable.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **533 g and 459 kcal**, including the milk, is plausible for the visible quantities. The solid food contributes about **327 g**. Allow roughly **20–25% uncertainty**, particularly for bread thickness, milk volume, and cooking oil.
